_comment: Removed a fabricated STATIC_TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND -> INTIMIDATE ability: the card has no intimidate text. 'Whenever you transcend' is the ON_TRANSCEND TRIGGER (CR 8.5.48), not a 'have transcended this turn' check — it was on ON_BECOME, which is the Arakni transform trigger and never fires for this card. NOTE: the activation cost is {c}{c}{c} (CHI), modelled here as a generic activation_cost of 3; chi is a separate pool (player.chi).
